label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method batch sampling pattern for large batches (100+ items). Full Santa on every item is cost-prohibitive. Pattern: 1) Run Santa on random sample (10-15% of batch, minimum 5 items), 2) Categorize failures by type (hallucination, compliance, completeness, etc.), 3) If systematic patterns emerge, apply targeted fixes to entire batch, 4) Re-sample and re-verify fixed batch, 5) Continue until clean sample passes. Reduces cost to ~15-20% of full verification while catching >90% of systematic issues. Code example: santa_batch function with random.sample, classify_failure, batch_fix, recursive re-sample. Three implementation patterns: Pattern A (Claude Code Subagents - recommended, true context isolation), Pattern B (Sequential Inline - fallback with explicit context resets), Pattern C (Batch Sampling - for large batches).
